resolution.question: Will the six university friends in the Ljubljana-trip group chat agree on dates and book the apartment before early-bird train fares end on the 15th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that all six friends have agreed on specific dates and the apartment has been booked (by Jaka or another) before 2026-08-15T23:59:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
